image_description: A close-up photograph of a ringlet butterfly (Aphantopus hyperantus) resting on a green leaf. The butterfly's wings are closed, showing the ventral side with characteristic brown coloration and a row of small eyespots (ocelli) with white centers. The body is slender and hairy, with visible clubbed antennae. The background consists of blurred green foliage.
